chart.title: The gap holds > delta flips
chart.subtitle: Sellers hit it. Price won't drop...

caption:
FVG tapped. Buy now? Wait for the FLIP. 🔍

Price pulls back into a bullish fair value gap at 24,470. Buying the first touch looks textbook, but the footprint shows sellers hitting the bid hard: delta -1,200 inside the gap. The difference is the result. Price stops making lower lows, the selling gets absorbed, and on the next bar the ask lifts through stacked buy imbalances and delta turns positive. That flip is the entry, not the touch.

1️⃣ The FVG tells you where to look, not when to buy
2️⃣ Heavy selling with no lower low = absorption, wait for delta to flip
3️⃣ If the far edge of the gap breaks with delta still negative, no trade
